elements.label: Mascot plush dropping from the top and landing in the centre foreground in front of the hero figure

pattern.description: Continuation of the end-card gag: another duplicate plush falls from above with heavy motion blur, passes behind the 'on duolingo' overlay and lands face-down in the centre foreground, now partly covering the hero figure in an ever-growing pile.
pattern.why_premium: Escalating physical comedy on a fixed typographic lockup; the text stays on top and legible while real objects with motion blur and soft contact shadows add tactile, handmade energy.

build_hint.gsap: Text layers static and above the object layer. gsap.fromTo('.plush', {y: -900, rotation: -30, filter: 'blur(8px)'}, {y: 0, rotation: 10, filter: 'blur(2px)', duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.in'}) followed by a short squash/settle (scaleY 0.92 -> 1, ease 'back.out(2)', 0.15s).
build_hint.remotion: const y = interpolate(frame - delay, [0, 12], [-900, 0], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.cubic), extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); then a spring({frame: frame - delay - 12, fps, config: {stiffness: 300, damping: 12}}) driving a small squash; keep text layers above and static.

notes: Live-action/puppet compositing. 'on duolingo' (b03) and 'LEARN CHESS' are static overlays; b03 only registers change because the plush passes behind it, so it is not listed. b02 is a union box over the fall path, not used to avoid duplicating the same plush. No SFX candidates; the spectrogram shows only rhythmic music.
